name: Largest first is not best
why: 3: 10 alone, 6 + 3 + 3 and 5 + 4 + 3. Placing the largest parcels first, each into the first wagon with room, needs 4.

name: In the given order is not best
why: 2: 3 + 7 twice. Filling wagons in the given order needs 3.

name: Exactly full
why: 3: a parcel that fills the wagon exactly still fits.

name: Eleven parcels
why: Trying every order of 11 parcels is about 40 million orders: too slow. The state is the set loaded so far.

name: Sixteen parcels
show: 16 random parcels from 1 to 70, wagons of 100
why: 2¹⁶ sets × 16 parcels is about a million steps. Trying every order (16!, about 2 × 10¹³) or every split into groups by submasks (3¹⁶, about 43 million) is too slow in Python.

name: Sixteen that fill four wagons
show: 16 parcels that fill 4 wagons of 1,000 exactly
why: 4. Each wagon must be filled exactly, which simple rules rarely find.
